class.name: GroundDust3D
class.brief_description: Dust lifted from dry sand by tyres, carried by the wind and settling back.
class.description: The silt a tyre lifts as it rolls and slides over dry, bare sand ([method GroundSurface3D.add_dust], linear in speed, sliding counts twice, none from damp sand), carried on a small grid that follows a target: advection by the wind and the plume's own jet, eddy diffusion, Stokes settling and deposition. Drawn as a [FogVolume] whose density texture is the dust's extinction, so the [Environment] needs volumetric fog enabled; the path tracer sees it on camera rays.

method.name: add_dust
method.description: Adds [param mass] kilograms of dust at [param position] with a starting jet of [param velocity].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all dust and resets the tallies.

method.name: get_airborne_mass
method.description: The dust in the air, in kilograms.

method.name: get_concentration_at
method.description: The dust concentration at [param position], in kilograms per cubic meter.

method.name: get_deposited_mass
method.description: The dust settled back to the ground since the last [method clear], in kilograms.

method.name: get_emitted_mass
method.description: The dust lifted since the last [method clear], in kilograms.

method.name: get_mass_extinction
method.description: The extinction per kilogram of dust of [member grain_diameter], in square meters per kilogram.

method.name: get_settling_speed
method.description: The Stokes settling speed of [member grain_diameter] grains, in meters per second.

members.member: How much the dust breaks into billows: 3D Worley noise erodes thin edges and thickens cores, so a plume reads as rolling clumps rather than a smooth haze. 0 draws the plain grid density.
Size of the largest billows, in meters. The noise drifts with the wind and rises slowly.
The size of the dust grid's cells, in meters.
Eddy diffusion near the ground, in square meters per second: how fast a plume spreads.
The colour of the dust (its scattering albedo).
The size of the dust grid, in meters. It follows [member follow_target], trailing it along its travel.
The node the dust grid follows, usually a vehicle. Empty: the viewport's current camera (as [GroundSurface3D] and the weather follow it), else this node.
The dust's grain diameter, in micrometers. Sets the Stokes settling speed and the extinction per kilogram.
The [GroundSurface3D] whose wheels lift the dust. Empty: the active one.
How fast the air slows a plume's own jet, in seconds.
Scales the drawn extinction; 1 is physical.
